landmarks.innerText: How fast is gigabit internet? With Xfinity's 1 Gig plan, you can download a full HD movie in seconds or update large video games in just a few minutes. But it's not just about download speed. Our fiber-powered Gig WiFi also features ultra-low lag, with a median latency of 13 milliseconds or below. This near-instant response time makes it the best choice for competitive online gaming and glitch-free video conferencing. How much does Xfinity Gig internet cost? We give you options to fit your budget. For a limited time, new customers can lock in our 1 Gig plan for $70/mo with our 5-Year Price Guarantee. Plus, our plans always come with no annual contracts and no early termination fees. Offer ends 7/21. New Xfinity Internet customers. Restrictions apply. Autopay w/ stored bank account and paperless billing req'd. Taxes and fees extra and subj. to change. What’s included with the 1 Gig home internet plan? • Fiber-powered Gig WiFi with ultra-low lag and large bandwidth • Unlimited data • Xfinity WiFi Gateway with Advanced Security and parental control features • One line of Mobile Select included for one year with Xfinity Mobile • Peacock Premium for 24 months on us • 4K TV Box on us Xfinity Internet is powered by fiber and connected to premises by coaxial cable. Peacock Premium: $10.99/mo value. Must activate within first 90 days. Xfinity Mobile requires Xfinity Internet. How long is Peacock Premium included in the 1 Gig plan? Our 1 Gig and faster speed plans currently include Peacock Premium ($10.99/mo value) for 24 months at no extra cost. That gives you two full years of your favorite shows, hit movies, and live sports included with your home internet service. Peacock Premium must be activated within first 90 days. Are there any data caps on Gigabit internet? No, we don't have data caps on our latest internet plans. Unlimited data is included on our 300 Mbps, 500 Mbps, and Gigabit plans. You can stream in 4K, download large game files, and run your smart home 24/7 without worrying about overage charges or throttled speeds. Mobile: Reduced speeds after 30 GB of usage/line. Data thresholds may vary. Xfinity Mobile req's Xfinity Int. Can I get speeds even faster than 1 Gig? If 1 Gig isn't enough for your hyper-connected home, we also offer 1.2 Gig and 2 Gig speeds in many areas. And for the ultimate in connectivity, we offer speeds up to 10 Gbps in select locations (call 1-800-934-6489 for details). How long does it take to set up my Gig internet at home? It doesn’t take long. You pick up your self-install equipment at an Xfinity store and can have your gig-speed network up and running in about 15 minutes. Just plug it in and use the Xfinity app for an easy step-by-step self-installation. If your home requires a technician to get connected, we offer professional installation appointments to get you set up. What is gigabit internet? One gigabit equals 1,000 Mbps. It provides increased bandwidth capacity, meaning your network won't get congested even when dozens of smart home devices, phones, and computers are connected at once. Plus, in many Xfinity areas, our gigabit tiers now offer symmetrical speeds, meaning your uploads are just as fast as your downloads.
